test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The financial powers of the chiefs of which Indian defence segments have been extended by the Home Ministry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Armed Police Forces.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The vice chiefs of the armed forces have been granted additional powers.
 
• It is to carry out specific procurements to ensure operational preparedness.
 
• Defence Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has approved the enhancement of powers to the vice chiefs of the three services.
 
• It is to make certain categories of procurement.
 
• This delegation will greatly enhance the ability of the armed forces to keep a high degree of serviceability of the in-service equipment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ministry of Home Affairs has enhanced the financial powers of the Chiefs of central armed police forces like CRPF and BSF.
 
• It empowers them to spend up to Rs **15 Cr** for executing major projects and Rs **1 Cr** for minor works including repairing of residential buildings.
 
• The director generals of** CISF, ITBP, SSB, NSG, Assam Rifles, **the** National Investigation Agency** will be able to exercise the financial powers. 
 
• The amount sanctioned for major projects has gone up to Rs 15 Cr from Rs 10 Cr previously.
 
• The fund for minor projects has also been increased to Rs 1 Cr from Rs 50 lakh previously.
